reason: An opt-in DeepSeek Harness plugin that monitors per-turn step counts and appends advisory wrap-up reminders after a configured budget without rejecting or rewriting steps.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可选插件，用于在智能体单轮步骤超过配置预算后追加收尾提醒。
summaries.en: An opt-in DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds wrap-up reminders when an agent turn exceeds its configured step budget.

capabilities: Reads durable session-log turn and step boundaries
Validates positive integer step-budget configuration during plugin load
Appends source-attributed advisory UserMessage reminders after configured step thresholds
Operates only when enabled through configuration
